stock.description: JTF International Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise, with its main business activities revolving around the blending and distribution of fuel oil throughout the People's Republic of China. The company also markets a variety of other petroleum and petrochemical products, including fuel, refined oil, methyl tertiary butyl ether, xylene, xylene mixture, and asphalt. Established in 2014, JTF International Holdings Limited's corporate headquarters are located in Guangzhou, China, and it functions as a subsidiary of Thrive Shine Limited.
